Architecture

Plex ODBC views are copied into BigQuery raw_* tables by one Cloud Run job per pipeline, then each pipeline's bq_view list is created on top of them. The probe decides whether a run needs to extract at all.

flowchart LR

  GCS["GCS voxdatalake-report-configs<br/>reports/ and test/ YAML, sql/"]
  AR["Artifact Registry<br/>one etl image for every job"]
  Mail["SendGrid report emails<br/>prod and test thread together"]
  subgraph PROD["PROD: dispatcher, probe can skip"]
    direction TB
    Sch["Cloud Scheduler<br/>plex-etl-dispatcher every 5 min"]
    Disp["Cloud Function<br/>etl-dispatcher"]
    Ops[("PlexOps<br/>etl_schedule, etl_dispatch_log")]
    ProdJobs["13 prod jobs plex-etl-pipeline<br/>RUN_MODE probe 1, 6, 11 PM / full 4 AM"]
    LDSch["Scheduler plex-label-design-sync<br/>hourly :00, explicit probe"]
    LDJob["plex-etl-label-design"]
    Prod[("PlexProd<br/>raw tables, views, probe_log")]
    Push["plex-etl-label-design-push :35"]
    Monday["Monday board Plex Import"]
    Apps["Apps Script manual data app"]
  end

    Test[("PlexTest<br/>raw tables, views, probe_log")]
  end

Prod vs Test

Same image, same code, two environments that run differently. Prod is started by the dispatcher and uses the probe to skip runs when Plex has not changed. Test is started once a night by Cloud Scheduler and always extracts in full: its probe is computed and logged but never allowed to skip.

flowchart TD
  P0["PROD: dispatcher tick finds a due slot"] --> P1{"slot mode"}
  P1 -->|"1 PM, 6 PM, 11 PM, follow-up"| P2["RUN_MODE=probe<br/>may_skip = true"]
  P1 -->|"4 AM"| P3["RUN_MODE=full<br/>may_skip = false"]
  T0["TEST: Cloud Scheduler nightly fire"] --> T1["RUN_MODE=scheduled<br/>auto probe: may_skip = false"]
  T0r["TEST: 9:45 PM -retry fire"] --> T2{"today's scheduled run<br/>success or partial?"}
  T2 -->|"yes"| T3["no-op, exits clean"]
  T2 -->|"no"| T4["RUN_MODE=retry<br/>full run"]
  P2 --> F["run_probe: fingerprint Plex + YAML + SQL"]
  P3 --> F
  T1 --> F
  F --> S{"may_skip and<br/>fingerprint unchanged?"}
  S -->|"yes: only prod probe runs get here"| K["SKIP extraction and views<br/>probe_log skipped"]
  S -->|"no"| X["Full extraction + views<br/>probe_log applied after a clean run"]
  T4 --> X

Schedules

Prod times live in PlexOps.etl_schedule and are started by the etl-dispatcher function. Change a prod time with SQL, not Terraform. Test jobs keep their own nightly Cloud Scheduler entries and never go through the dispatcher.

sequenceDiagram
  participant CS as Cloud Scheduler
  participant D as etl-dispatcher
  participant BQ as PlexOps in BigQuery
  participant CR as Cloud Run job
  participant PX as Plex ODBC
  CS->>D: HTTP tick every 5 minutes
  D->>BQ: read etl_schedule and open etl_dispatch_log rows
  D->>CR: reconcile open runs from execution status
  D->>BQ: record failed, succeeded-unrecorded or lost
  D->>BQ: insert dispatch row for each due slot first
  D->>CR: run job with RUN_MODE, DISPATCH_ID, DISPATCH_LOG_TABLE
  CR->>PX: probe aggregates
  alt fingerprint unchanged and mode is probe
    CR->>BQ: probe_log skipped, outcome skipped
  else changed or full mode
    CR->>PX: full extraction
    CR->>BQ: write raw tables and views, probe_log applied
    CR->>BQ: outcome success, partial or failed
  end
  D->>BQ: next tick finds failed, partial or lost run
  D->>CR: one follow-up probe 15 minutes after it finished

Probe logic

flowchart TD
  Start["Job starts<br/>RUN_MODE probe, full, scheduled or retry"]
  Load["Load YAML from GCS<br/>open Plex ODBC connection"]
  Kind{"probe_kind<br/>auto, explicit or none"}
  Full["Full extraction<br/>WRITE_TRUNCATE every raw table"]
  Ref["Read last applied fingerprint<br/>from probe_log"]
  Run["run_probe<br/>COUNT and MAX or SUM per table<br/>plus YAML and SQL hash"]
  Inc["Inconclusive<br/>log inconclusive row, fail open"]
  Same{"May skip and<br/>fingerprint unchanged"}
  Skip["Log skipped<br/>short Probe ran email<br/>outcome skipped"]
  Views["Create or replace bq_views<br/>retry a failed view once"]
  Ok{"Clean run"}
  Applied["probe_log applied<br/>fingerprint is new reference"]
  Failed["probe_log failed<br/>reference unchanged"]
  Disp["record_dispatch_outcome<br/>full email"]
  Follow["Dispatcher follow-up probe<br/>15 min later, once"]
  Start --> Load --> Kind
  Kind -->|"none"| Full
  Kind -->|"auto or explicit"| Ref
  Ref -->|"unreadable"| Inc
  Ref --> Run
  Run -->|"error"| Inc
  Run --> Same
  Inc --> Full
  Same -->|"yes"| Skip
  Same -->|"no, or full run"| Full
  Full --> Views --> Ok
  Ok -->|"yes"| Applied --> Disp
  Ok -->|"no"| Failed --> Disp
  Disp -->|"failed, partial or lost"| Follow

  Dev --> Hook --> PR --> Main
  Main --> Deploy --> Guard --> Review --> TF --> GCS
  TF --> Tag
  Main -->|"code changes"| CB --> Img
  Main -->|"function changes"| GF
